headline: Domino's Pizza (DPZ) World Cup Sales Buzz Leaves Valuation Back In Focus
summary: Recent reports on Domino's Pizza (DPZ) highlight strong first half like for like sales and one of its biggest sales days during an England World Cup match, helped by heatwave driven takeaway demand. See our latest analysis for Domino's Pizza.
